title: [ARKNIGHTS X MONSTER HUNTER] SIDESTORY: A FLURRY TO THE FLAME RERUN
lines: 01 [ARKNIGHTS X MONSTER HUNTER] SIDESTORY: A FLURRY TO THE FLAME RERUN
DURATION: November 30, 2026, 08:00 - December 14, 2026, 03:59 (UTC-7)
UNLOCK REQUIREMENT: Clear Main Storyline 1-10
DETAILS: A Flurry to the Flame event stages will be open for a limited time. Players can obtain event rewards by clearing event stages, completing event missions, and redeeming from Event Store.
EVENT STAGE DURATION:
[Soubo Mountains] & [Commeowssion Counter]
DURATION: November 30, 2026, 08:00 - December 10, 2026, 03:59 (UTC-7)
[Roka Village Quest Board]
DETAILS: During the event, players can complete [Roka Village Quest Board] missions by clearing event stages to gain rewards.
REWARDS: [★: Terra Research Commission] and its token, Module Materials, Melding Materials, etc.
[Arts Melder]
DURATION: November 30, 2026, 08:00 - December 14, 2026, 03:59 (UTC-7)

DETAILS: During the event, players can obtain [Melding Materials] by clearing event stages and completing [Roka Village Quest Board] missions. [Melding Materials] can be used to redeem rewards from [Arts Melder].
REWARDS: Momiji Hotel Furniture (Pieces), Headhunting Permit, Elite Materials, LMD, Battle Records, etc.
NOTE:
- This rerun event is a lightweight rerun; event stages will inherit the player's previous event stage progress and first-time drop progress.

- Some non-repeatable event rewards during this rerun can be converted into [Intelligence Certificate] at a corresponding ratio when obtained again. The conversion rates can be found in the event's Intelligence Certificate Conversion Rules.
- The [Intelligence Certificate] shop will restock additional quantities of existing items and add new items when the event starts.
- Trust gain for Kirin R Yato, Rathalos S Noir Corne, and Terra Research Commission will be increased in the event stages of this rerun.
02 [ARKNIGHTS X MONSTER HUNTER] LIMITED-TIME HEADHUNTING RERUN – SHARPENED BY FLAME
DURATION: November 30, 2026, 08:00 - December 14, 2026, 03:59 (UTC-7)
DETAILS: During the event, the Limited-time Headhunting, [Sharpened By Flame], opens and the following Operators will appear at a higher rate:
★★★★★★: Kirin R Yato
★★★★★: Rathalos S Noir Corne
- This headhunting is a [Triumphant Hunt Headhunting]

- Operators Kirin R Yato and Rathalos S Noir Corne are currently ONLY available from the Limited Headhunting, Triumphant Hunt Headhunting, and are NOT available in any Standard Headhuntings or Kernel Headhunting.
- In [Triumphant Hunt Headhunting], Operator Kirin R Yato is guaranteed every 120 pulls, and the count resets each time Operator Kirin R Yato is obtained.

- In [Triumphant Hunt Headhunting], if the current rate-up 5★ Operator is not obtained within the first 50 headhunting attempts, the next 5★ Operator obtained is guaranteed to be the current rate-up 5★ Operator.
- Please refer to the official notice of this Limited Headhunting for more details.
03 RE-EDITION FURNITURE SET – MOMIJI HOTEL
DETAILS: This furniture set will be available again during the event.
HOW TO OBTAIN:
- A Flurry to the Flame event rewards and redeemable (Pieces)
- Limited-time sale at the Store (Pieces)
DURATION: November 30, 2026, 08:00 - December 14, 2026, 03:59
04 LIMITED-TIME PACK AVAILABLE
DURATION: November 30, 2026, 08:00 - December 14, 2026, 03:59 (UTC-7)
DETAILS: During the event, the following pack will be available from the Store for a limited time.
Specialist Chip Pack
CONTENTS: Specialist Dualchip * 4, Specialist Chip * 5, Skill Summary - 3 * 45, Skill Summary - 2 * 25, Skill Summary - 1 * 10
Please stay tuned for more information!
